record.title: Evaluate readiness for the guest ordinary-entitlement trial
record.intent: Admit the next smallest justified installer experiment or environment correction from the recovered contract and baseline evidence.
requirements: Compare the baseline outcome with the statically recovered ordinary interface and explicit identity/persistence requirements. A negative baseline is valid progress; do not change its question retroactively.

If the baseline is coherent, draft a bounded disposable-guest installer and persistence trial followed by its evaluation. Otherwise admit only one evidence-supported environment correction or record the exact unresolved bench question.

Keep ordinary entitlements, the separate guest D-capability experiment, full board-image boot and physical mutations as distinct questions. Physical entitlement and 1 GHz transitions remain at their later authorization gates.
Run taskctl plan, inspect, admit against the expected revision, and commit and push any successor tasking before execution. Commit and push the decision evidence.
acceptance: The next guest step or precise blocker is decided from evidence.
